name: Pila Pharma AB (publ)
summary: Based in Sweden, PILA PHARMA AB (publ) is a pharmaceutical firm actively engaged in clinical development. The company's principal drug, XEN-D0501, is a TRPV1 antagonist which has successfully completed two phase 2a clinical studies aimed at treating type 2 diabetes. PILA PHARMA AB (publ) was founded in 2014 and maintains its headquarters in Malmö, Sweden.
